g.text: RAM address direction vs. sample write order
One channel bank, slot 2. Each S is one 32-bit IQ16 sample; S0 is the first sample stored in this slot.
RAM addresses increase DOWN each lane. Samples are written ACROSS lanes 0–7, then on the next row.
